character_bambo_subtitle: The iconic red-bandana hero of classic Boxhead
character_bind_subtitle: A cool, precise agent in a black suit
character_sakamoto_subtitle: A black-clad fighter built for precision movement
weapon_pistol_description: The infinite-ammo starting weapon. Fast Fire unlocks at 3x and Double Damage at 8x.
weapon_uzi_description: Unlocks at 5x. Later upgrades improve fire rate, range, ammunition, and damage.
weapon_shotgun_description: Unlocks at 10x. Later upgrades improve fire rate, ammunition, range, and spread.
weapon_barrel_description: Unlocks at 15x. Place it at the player’s position and detonate it with gunfire or another explosion.
weapon_grenade_description: Unlocks at 20x. Throw repeatedly and later unlock cluster explosions.
weapon_wall_description: Unlocks at 30x. Place a white octagonal fake wall to block the horde.
weapon_mine_description: Unlocks at 40x. Flashes red and detonates after an enemy steps on it.
weapon_rocket_description: Unlocks at 50x. A heavy shoulder-mounted launcher that can later gain rapid fire.
weapon_charge_pack_description: Unlocks at 55x. Place it, then press fire again to detonate it remotely.
weapon_railgun_description: Unlocks at 70x. A high-damage electromagnetic beam that pierces rows of enemies.
map_viewer_description: Inspect room maps, collision grids, and monster spawn points.
map_viewer_select_room: Select a room to inspect or deploy ({count})
model_studio_description: Inspect and manage in-game Blockbench models, bones, and animations.
model_studio_select_model: Select a .bbmodel to inspect or export ({count})
model_studio_upload: Upload a modified .bbmodel to update the model live
map_viewer_technical_overview: Every arena includes 2.5D wall shadows, camera-visible roomBounds, and pathfinding grids for the original marker points (1 / 2 / P / Z / D / B / W).
map_viewer_node_help: Toggle nodes and red limits to inspect original spawn coordinates. The minimap toggle is available in the lobby OPTIONS menu.
armory_header: BOXHEAD 2PLAY ROOMS · WAVE {wave} · ORIGINAL UPGRADE LIST
armory_storage_hint: P1 and P2 weapon ammo and evolution are stored independently and synced to localStorage. Disabling maxed weapons restores the previous values.
armory_weapon_hint: Pistol, UZI, and Shotgun use instant hitscan trails. Barrels, fake walls, mines, and charge packs are placed at the character’s position.
model_import_success: Parsed “{file}” successfully and updated its 3D cubes and skeletal rig in game.
model_studio_overview: All characters, zombies, bosses, weapons, equipment, and supply crates use native .bbmodel skeletal models with continuous 360° rotation and live joint animation.
model_weapon_mount: Attach a weapon .bbmodel to the right-hand weapon_mount_bone:
model_texture_animation_badge: Embedded 64×64 PNG texture and complete skeletal animations
model_texture_animation_help: Every .bbmodel embeds its color texture for complete Blockbench rendering and includes all keyframe animations.

poster_description: Every character, monster, weapon, and tactical item is an independent .bbmodel file integrated under /assets.
